definitions.gloss: garden tree, yard tree, ornamental tree
definitions.explanation: A tree planted in a garden or yard, typically for decorative purposes. Includes both ornamental and fruit-bearing trees grown in residential gardens.

examples.japanese: {庭木|にわき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{庭木|にわき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I pruned the branches of the garden trees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{庭木|にわき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れて→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: A garden tree was knocked over by the typhoon, so I asked a contractor to remove it.

notes:
USAGE:
A common everyday word for trees in residential gardens. Japanese gardens often feature carefully maintained {庭木|にわき}, and tree maintenance (especially ⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧, pruning) is an important part of homeownership.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {庭木|にわき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: tending garden trees
- {庭木|にわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧: to plant a garden tree
- {庭木|にわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prune garden trees
- {庭木|にわき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧: garden trees grow thick
